The Lounge

A cut above the ordinary barbershop

Hyde Barber Lounge pairs the craft of a traditional barbershop with the calm of a lounge. Settle into the chair, and every service — from a sharp skin fade to a slow hot towel shave — is done unrushed, precise, and finished with care.

It is the kind of place Panorama Ridge keeps coming back to: consistent fades, clean line ups, and a chair that feels like a break in your day, not an errand.
